paragraphs.text: 1. O THE Wind's chariot, O its power and glory! Crashing it goes and hath a voice of thunder.
paragraphs.original: वातस्य नु महिमानं रथस्य रुजन्नेति स्तनयन्नस्य घोषः ।
paragraphs.translit: vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujanneti stanayannasya ghoṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: It makes the regions red and touches heaven, and as it moves the dust of earth is scattered.
2. Along the traces of the Wind they hurry, they come to him as dames to an assembly.
paragraphs.original: सं प्रेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गच्छन्ति समनं न योषाः ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Borne on his car with these for his attendants, the God speeds forth, the universe's Monarch.
paragraphs.original: ताभिः सयुक्सरथं देव ईयतेऽस्य विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा
paragraphs.translit: tābhiḥ sayuksarathaṃ deva īyate'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā

paragraphs.text: 3. Travelling on the paths of air's mid region, no single day doth he take rest or slumber.
paragraphs.original: अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिरीयमानो न नि विशते कतमच्चनाहः ।
paragraphs.translit: antarikṣe pathibhirīyamāno na ni viśate katamaccanāhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Holy and earliest-born, Friend of the waters, where did he spring and from what region came he?
paragraphs.original: अपां सखा प्रथमजा ऋतावा क्व स्विज्जातः कुत आ बभूव
paragraphs.translit: apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā kva svijjātaḥ kuta ā babhūva

paragraphs.text: 4. Germ of the world, the Deities' vital spirit, this God moves ever as his will inclines him.
paragraphs.original: आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गर्भो यथावशं चरति देव एषः ।
paragraphs.translit: ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: His voice is heard, his shape is ever viewless. Let us adore this Wind with our oblation.
paragraphs.original: घोषा इदस्य शृण्विरे न रूपं तस्मै वाताय हविषा विधेम
paragraphs.translit: ghoṣā idasya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema
